items.title: Electra targets $342m IPO to fund hyperinflammatory syndrome drug’s pivotal trials
items.summary: Electra likens its targeted approach in immune-mediated disease to what precision oncology has achieved in cancer.

items.title: Agentic AI trust gap slowing healthcare provider adoption, survey reveals
items.summary: As healthcare providers begin to embed agentic AI into their workflows, effective governance and accountability becomes key.

items.title: GSK bolsters oncology pipeline with $750m Chimagen TCE deal
items.summary: GSK plans to take the TCE to Phase I clinical trials in multiple myeloma during 2027, adding to the company's growing oncology pipeline.

items.title: Definium tees up regulatory submission for psychedelic on Phase III hat trick
items.summary: Definium Therapeutics plans to submit an NDA for LSD-based psychedelic, DT120 in generalised anxiety disorder (GAD) during H1 2027.

items.title: Cheplapharm to take over 20 medicines and three sites from Sanofi
items.summary: Cheplapharm has entered into a strategic partnership to take over a portfolio of 20 mature medicines along with three manufacturing facilities globally from Sanofi.
